description:
JSX-block conditionals ({if cond do} ... {else} ... {end}) compile to a regular Elixir if expression that returns a vnode (or {:fragment, [...]}). Slots via inner_block emit a closure that returns a vnode, integrated with parent-element vnode children. ## Files - lib/filament/vnode_engine.ex - lib/filament/tag_engine.ex (jsx_else, jsx_end, slot handle_token branches, inner_block macro) ## Acceptance - {if active do}
on
{else}
off
{end} emits a conditional vnode at runtime. - Slot examples (existing tests) still render correctly. - :if attribute on elements/components emits a conditional vnode wrapping the element/component.
title: Phase 1.4.4: Conditionals + slots in vnode IR
